title: eyeprocesspy: Vendor-neutral Python infrastructure for eye-tracking and multimodal process data
description: eyeprocesspy is vendor-neutral Python infrastructure aligned to the frozen R eyeprocess 0.11.1 reference. Version 0.2.2 adds measurement-validity and dynamic-gaze capabilities including target-referenced spatial calibration error fields, pupil-size artefact modelling, vendor-neutral dynamic AOIs, smooth-pursuit and microsaccade analysis, event-detector benchmarking, naturalistic coordinate transforms, scanpath metric sensitivity, eye-tracking stress simulation, and a completed Bayesian-network robustness layer with CPT, structural, discretization, measurement-noise, sample-size, and predictive-calibration analyses. The release preserves existing preprocessing, data-quality, survival-analysis, psychometric, multimodal, parity, provenance, and exact-coverage safeguards.
